stem.text: A wire is fixed at one end and is extended by a force $F_1$ acting on the other end. This causes the wire to have an elastic potential energy of $0.15\,\text{J}$.
The force applied to the wire is now changed to a force $F_2$. This causes the wire to have a new elastic potential energy of $0.60\,\text{J}$.
What is the relationship between $F_1$ and $F_2$?
